(The city's tourism/hospitality tax runs through the separate Hot Springs Advertising & Promotion Commission and is outside this total.)

nodes.name: General Fund
nodes.note: The city's main operating fund, broken out by department. Police and Fire are their own funds (below), subsidized from here via Special Appropriations.

nodes.name: Street (incl. Street-Highway Tax & Our Roads Now)
Hot Springs Advertising & Promotion Commission (Visit Hot Springs)
nodes.note: A separate seven-member commission, funded by the city's 3% tax on prepared food and lodging, that runs tourism promotion, the Hot Springs Convention Center, and Bank OZK Arena (CEO Steve Arrison). Reported at ≈$16.1M for 2026, adopted Dec 8, 2025 (Sentinel Record). The commission's own budget document — with the division breakdown (advertising, convention center, arena operations, debt service, capital) and the exact figure — is not posted publicly; it is a records request. A rounded, secondary figure until that document is ingested.
